Home shows only your selected favorites. New apps stay in All apps until you add them. Hold OK on a Home tile to move or remove it.
Home uses a horizontal favorite shelf. All apps uses the column count above. Static glass surfaces keep the interface light on 1 GB devices.
Choose a city manually; no GPS or account. City search sends the typed name; forecasts send its coordinates. Refresh runs while Home is visible. Latest successful data is saved for offline use.

Allow Notification Access for music controls

Enable CleanYourTV Custom music controls in Android Notification Access, then play Spotify and return Home. This app reads local media sessions, not notification messages. No Spotify password or Web API is used.

Controls appear only for an active Spotify session, including paused playback. Artwork, duration and buttons depend on Spotify. Shuffle, likes and Spotify Connect are not included. Some TV firmware does not offer Notification Access.
This firmware does not expose Notification Access settings. Music controls may be unavailable; other launcher features still work.

Test build. Validate remote navigation, memory and Spotify on your own TV before choosing it as default Home. The original launcher stays installed.
